description: Read Zillow home details by listing URL, ZPID, or street address, or list homes by 5 digit ZIP code. Returns one flat row per home with price, Zestimate, beds, baths, area, status, and the listing agent shown on MLS listings. Blocked and missing homes are free rows. Costs 0.006 USD per home page read, 0.002 USD per ZIP code search row, plus 0.007 USD per run start.

listing_status.description: for_sale (default), for_rent, or recently_sold. Used only with ZIP codes.

listings.description: Zillow home URLs, ZPIDs, or street addresses, up to 1,000 per run. An address must include a street number and a city or ZIP code, and it must match the home Zillow returns, or you get a free row.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_listings.description: The most homes to return in this run, across every input in order, from 1 to 1,000. Default 100. Text or a number.

read_details.description: false (default) or true. With false, a ZIP code returns one search row per home at the search row price. With true, the actor reads each home's page at the listing row price, which adds the description and the listing agent.

zip_codes.description: 5 digit US ZIP codes. Each returns the homes on Zillow's search pages for that ZIP code, up to Maximum listings.

name: read_zillow_listings
title: Read Zillow listing details
